hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.name: CodeInput
hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.doc: One-time code / PIN boxes: `<CodeInput length={6} groups={[3, 3]} onComplete={verify} />`. Typing moves forward, Backspace back, ← → move, paste fills from the box (extra characters are cut). Colors, font, size and variant are props; in the HADİ theme each box takes the next HADİ color and the display font, as in the HADİ apps.

props.name: length
props.doc: Number of boxes, 3–12 (default 6).

props.name: pattern
props.doc: Characters allowed: "numeric" (default; numeric keypad, one-time-code autofill), "alpha" or "alphanumeric".

props.name: uppercase
props.doc: Force capitals (default true for letters).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Visual groups, e.g. [3, 3] → "123 456" with a separator between the groups.

props.name: mask
props.doc: Hide the characters (PINs).

props.name: colors
props.doc: Box colors: "single" (the accent / `color`), "brand" (the four HADİ colors in turn — the HADİ theme's default), "palette" (the theme's categorical colors) or a list of color tokens.

props.name: font
props.doc: Digits font: "display" (the theme's display face — HADİ: Bricolage; the HADİ default), "mono" or "body".

props.name: variant
props.doc: "outline" (default), "filled" or "underline".

props.name: animate
props.doc: Pop the character in (default true; off with prefers-reduced-motion). `false`: no motion; a function: your own (`(box) => animate(box, …)`).

props.name: separator
props.doc: The mark between groups: `false` removes it, a node / text / `() => node` replaces the drawn dash.

props.name: boxLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of a box: `(position, length) => text` (default "Character 2 of 6").

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#CodeInput.tr: Tek kullanımlık kod / PIN kutuları: `<CodeInput length={6} groups={[3, 3]} onComplete={verify} />`. Yazmak ileri, Backspace geri götürür, ← → gezinir, yapıştırma kutudan doldurur (fazla karakterler kesilir). Renkler, yazı tipi, boyut vb. ayarlanabilir.

hadi-march/ui#CodeView.name: CodeView
hadi-march/ui#CodeView.doc: Read-only code block with line numbers: `<CodeView code={src} lang="js" wrap={false} copy />`

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Colour tokens (default: on when `lang` is known: js/ts/jsx/tsx, css, html, json, sh).

props.name: tools
props.doc: Extra toolbar controls (widget actions), placed after Wrap.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: The whole toolbar (default true); false leaves only the code.

props.name: langLabel
props.doc: The language label in the toolbar: your own text or node, or false to hide it (default: `lang`).

props.name: wrapButton
props.doc: The Wrap toggle button (default true).

props.name: wrapLabel
props.doc: Text of the Wrap button (default "Wrap", translated).

props.name: copyLabel
props.doc: Text of the copy button (default "Copy", translated).

hadi-march/ui#CodeView.tr: Satır numaralı salt okunur kod bloğu: `<CodeView code={src} lang="js" wrap={false} copy />`

hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.name: CodeViewer
hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.doc: Default main provider: read-only, coloured, file switcher for multi-file examples.
hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.signature: function CodeViewer(input: CodeViewInput, ctx?: WidgetContext<CodeViewInput>): Element

props.name: apply
props.doc: Live editors call this with the edited source (the demo re-runs it).

props.name: reset
props.doc: Back to the original source.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Set when drawn inside the fullscreen dialog (the Fullscreen action hides itself).

hadi-march/ui#CodeViewer.tr: Varsayılan ana sağlayıcı: salt okunur, renklendirilmiş, çok dosyalı örnekler için dosya değiştirici.

hadi-march/ui#col.name: col
hadi-march/ui#col.tr: Hazır düzende üst üste duran çocuklar: `col([ağırlık, çocuk], …)`.

hadi-march/ui#colorAt.name: colorAt
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.doc: The color of the gradient at a position (0–100), in sRGB — for a stop added on the bar.
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.signature: function colorAt(g: Gradient, at: number): string
hadi-march/ui#colorAt.tr: Gradyanın bir konumdaki (0–100) rengi, sRGB olarak — çubuğa eklenen bir durak için.

hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.name: ColorInput
hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.doc: Color: native swatch picker plus a #RRGGBB text field.

props.name: swatch
props.doc: The native swatch picker: `false` leaves only the text field.

props.name: text
props.doc: The #RRGGBB text field: `false` leaves only the swatch.

props.name: swatchLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the swatch (default "Pick a color").

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the text field (default "#RRGGBB").

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorInput.tr: Renk: yerel örnek seçici ve #RRGGBB metin alanı.

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.name: ColorPicker
hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.doc: Color picker: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. The value is a CSS color string in the chosen format.

props.name: alpha
props.doc: Alpha slider and alpha in the value (default true).

props.name: format
props.doc: Text format of the value (default "hex"); the switcher changes it.

props.name: palettes
props.doc: Palettes under the picker. Default: HADİ colors, the theme palette and recent picks.

props.name: recent
props.doc: Recent picks kept (default 8; 0 hides them).

props.name: eyedropper
props.doc: Eyedropper button where the browser has one (default true).

props.name: contrast
props.doc: Contrast against white and black (default true).

props.name: preview
props.doc: The old / new preview next to the sliders (default true).

props.name: formats
props.doc: The HEX / RGB / HSL switcher (default true).

props.name: input
props.doc: The text field with the value (default true).

props.name: eyedropperIcon
props.doc: Own eyedropper icon (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts: names of the sliders, the buttons and the default palettes.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ColorPicker.tr: Renk seçici: `<ColorPicker bind:value={$c} />`. Değer, seçilen biçimde bir CSS renk dizesidir.

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.name: Combobox
hadi-march/ui#Combobox.doc: Props: options (static) or search(q) → Promise<options>; debounce (ms, 250); minChars (0 static / 1 async); limit (50); placeholder; renderOption(o); labelOf(value) (label for a value not in options); allowCustom (typed text becomes the value); multiple (array value, chips); onSelect(option). Options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: options
props.doc: Static options: [value] or [{ value, label, hint, disabled }].

props.name: search
props.type: ((q: string) => Promise<readonly unknown[]> | readonly unknown[]) | undefined
props.doc: Async options for the typed text.

props.name: minChars
props.doc: Characters before searching (0 static / 1 async).

props.name: labelOf
props.doc: Label for a value that is not in the options.

props.name: allowCustom
props.doc: Typed text becomes the value.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Array value, chips.

props.name: labels
props.type: { searching?: unknown; typeToSearch?: unknown; noResults?: unknown; searchFailed?: ((message: string) => unknown) | undefined; remove?: ((label: string) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Texts the list and the chips write themselves (defaults: "Searching…", "Type to search", "No results", "Search failed: …", "Remove …").

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: The remove button of a chip (`multiple`): `false` removes it (Backspace still removes), a node / text / `() => node` replaces the "×".

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Combobox.tr: Arama kutulu seçim: statik options ya da eşzamansız search(q); gecikme, en az karakter, sınır ve özel değer seçenekleriyle.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.name: CommandPalette
hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.doc: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (ids of commands/pages/actions). The dialog itself loads on first open.

props.name: ask
props.type: (query: string) => Promise<{ results?: readonly AskResult[] | null } | null | undefined>
props.doc: Optional intent search: resolves ids of commands/pages/actions (or hrefs) with a reason.

props.name: askDelay
props.doc: ms before `ask` runs by itself when local results are weak (default 600).

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Toggle shortcut (default "mod+k"); false = none.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Maximum local results (default 50).

props.name: commands
props.doc: Extra commands for this palette only.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts (dialog and field names, empty state, key hint, the Ask row).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The key hint under the list: true (default), false, or your own content.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Own content for "no results" (default: the `labels.empty` text).

props.name: askIcon
props.doc: Icon of the Ask row (default: sparkles); false: none.

props.name: class
props.doc: Extra class on the dialog.

hadi-march/ui#CommandPalette.tr: `<CommandPalette ask={(q) => api.intent(q)} placeholder="…" shortcut="mod+k" limit={50} commands={[…]} />` ask(query) → Promise<{ results: [{ id, reason }] }> (komut/sayfa/eylem kimlikleri). Diyalogun kendisi tembel yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#confirm.name: confirm
hadi-march/ui#confirm.doc: Ask a yes/no question. Resolves true (ok) or false (cancel, Escape, overlay).
hadi-march/ui#confirm.tr: Evet/hayır sorusu sorar. true (tamam) veya false (iptal, Escape, kaplama) ile sonuçlanır.

hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.name: connectionFeature
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.doc: A badge in a corner while the browser is offline (announced politely).
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.valueType: (opts?: { corner?: Corner; label?: string; } | undefined) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#connectionFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: bağlantı kopunca köşede "çevrimdışı" rozeti gösterir.

hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.name: consentFeature
hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.doc: The cookie / storage consent banner (texts can be given; the decision is the consent manager's).
hadi-march/ui#consentFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: çerez ve depolama onay bandı (karar onay yöneticisinindir).

hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.name: contrastOf
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.doc: WCAG contrast ratio of two colors (1–21; alpha ignored), with the theme's contrast helper.
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.signature: function contrastOf(a: Rgba, b: Rgba): number
hadi-march/ui#contrastOf.tr: İki rengin WCAG karşıtlık oranı (1–21; alfa yok sayılır), temanın karşıtlık yardımcısıyla.

hadi-march/ui#convert.name: convert
hadi-march/ui#convert.doc: Convert a value to another type, keeping what can be kept.
hadi-march/ui#convert.signature: function convert(v: unknown, to: Exclude<JsonType, "integer">): unknown
hadi-march/ui#convert.tr: Bir değeri başka türe çevirir, korunabilecekleri korur.

hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.name: CopyButton
hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.doc: Copy text to the clipboard: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`

props.name: copiedLabel
props.doc: Text (or accessible name when icon-only) shown after a copy. Default: "Copied" (translated).

props.name: icon
props.doc: The copy icon: your own node / icon. A text button has no icon unless one is given (`true`: the default one).

props.name: copiedIcon
props.doc: The icon after a copy (default: a tick): your own node / icon, or false to keep the copy icon.

props.name: copiedColor
props.doc: Colour of the button after a copy (default: success).

props.name: duration
props.doc: How long the "Copied" state stays, ms (default 1500).

props.name: errorText
props.doc: Text of the failure toast; false: no toast (use `onError`).

props.name: onError
props.doc: The clipboard refused (no permission, insecure page).

hadi-march/ui#CopyButton.tr: Metni panoya kopyalar: `<CopyButton text={() => token} label="Copy" />`

hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.name: cornerControls
hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.doc: The element of a corner: the rendered one, else made and put at the end of <body>.
hadi-march/ui#cornerControls.tr: Bir köşenin öğesi: çizilmiş olan, yoksa katman yığınında oluşturulan.

hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.name: CornerControls
hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.doc: Renders a corner in place; controls added to it go in here (a corner made earlier hands its controls over).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the corner group (default "Page controls").

hadi-march/ui#CornerControls.tr: Bir köşeyi yerinde çizer; o köşeye eklenen denetimler buraya gelir.

hadi-march/ui#CornerMark.name: CornerMark
hadi-march/ui#CornerMark.doc: `<CornerMark icon={video} />`, `<CornerMark corner="bottom-end" icon={plus} variant="solid" color="brand-orange" ring overlap />`

props.name: corner
props.doc: Which corner (logical: "end" is the right side in left-to-right text). Default "top-end".

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon (an icon, text or a node); children work too.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "scrim" (default: dark glass, for photos), "surface" (card colour with a shadow) or "solid" (filled with the colour).

props.name: ring
props.doc: A ring in the surface colour around the mark (cuts it out of an avatar).

props.name: show
props.doc: "always" (default) or "hover": shown while an ancestor with class `m-corner-host` is hovered or has focus inside.

props.name: overlap
props.doc: Sits half outside the corner (a badge on an avatar) instead of inside it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name; without it the mark is decorative.

hadi-march/ui#CornerMark.tr: Resmin, kartın ya da avatarın köşesindeki küçük yuvarlak işaret (video, ok, artı): `<CornerMark icon={video} />`

hadi-march/ui#CORNERS.name: CORNERS
hadi-march/ui#CORNERS.doc: The four corners a control can sit in, in logical terms (start / end follow the writing direction).
hadi-march/ui#CORNERS.tr: Bir denetimin durabileceği dört köşe, mantıksal adlarla (start / end yazı yönünü izler).

hadi-march/ui#CountRoll.name: CountRoll

props.name: format
props.doc: compact: 1,2 B · full: 1.234 (grouped). Default compact.

props.name: hideZero
props.doc: Hide at 0 (an empty count next to an icon).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Roll duration (ms). Default 320.

props.name: formatter
props.doc: Your own visible text for a value: `(n) => "1.2k likes"` (screen readers still get the full number).

props.name: spoken
props.doc: Your own text for screen readers: `(n) => "1,234 likes"` (default: the full grouped number).

props.name: roll
props.doc: Roll on change. Default true; false swaps the digits at once (as reduced motion does).

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Delay between neighbouring digits (ms). Default 24.

hadi-march/ui#CountRoll.tr: `<CountRoll value={$likes} />` — sayı değişimini yuvarlanma animasyonuyla gösterir.

hadi-march/ui#coverScale.name: coverScale
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.doc: Scale (screen px per image px) at zoom 1: the rotated image just covers a fw × fh frame.
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.signature: function coverScale(iw: number, ih: number, fw: number, fh: number, deg: number): number
hadi-march/ui#coverScale.tr: Zoom 1'de ölçek (görsel pikseli başına ekran pikseli): döndürülmüş görsel fw × fh çerçevesini tam kaplar.

hadi-march/ui#createDebugSession.name: createDebugSession
hadi-march/ui#createDebugSession.doc: `const s = createDebugSession({ evaluate })`; instrumented code reports to it once `s.begin(metas)` ran.
hadi-march/ui#createDebugSession.tr: Hata ayıklama oturumu: enstrümante kodun adımlarını değişkenleriyle kaydeder; kesme noktaları, izlenenler, adımlama ve değerlendirme (localStorage'da kalıcı olabilir).

hadi-march/ui#creditFeature.name: creditFeature
hadi-march/ui#creditFeature.doc: "Developed with March and 💗" — in the footer when there is one, else a small line in a corner.
hadi-march/ui#creditFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: köşede küçük bir "March ile yapıldı" yazısı ya da rozeti.

hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.name: cropToCanvas
hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.doc: Draw the cropped image on a canvas. `width` is the output width (default: the image's own resolution across the frame); the height follows the frame's aspect.
hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.signature: function cropToCanvas(img: CanvasImageSource & { naturalWidth?: number; naturalHeight?: number; width?: number | SVGAnimatedLength; height?: number | SVGAnimatedLength }, st: CropState, view: { width: number; height: number }, opts: { width?: number; canvas?: HTMLCanvasElement } = {}): HTMLCanvasElement

params.name: img
params.type: CanvasImageSource & { naturalWidth?: number; naturalHeight?: number; width?: number | SVGAnimatedLength; height?: number | SVGAnimatedLength }

hadi-march/ui#cropToCanvas.tr: Kırpılmış görseli bir canvas'a çizer. `width` çıktı genişliğidir (varsayılan: görselin çerçeve boyunca kendi çözünürlüğü); yükseklik çerçevenin en-boy oranını izler.

hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.name: currencyInfo
hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.doc: Currency symbol, its side and the currency's minor digits for a locale.
hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.signature: function currencyInfo(loc: string | undefined, currency: string): { symbol: string; prefix: boolean; digits: number }

returns.type: { symbol: string; prefix: boolean; digits: number }

hadi-march/ui#currencyInfo.tr: Bir dil için para birimi simgesi, tarafı ve para biriminin küçük birim basamakları.

hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.name: DatePicker
hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.doc: Date input with a calendar popover. Value: ISO date string or null. Props: min, max, firstDay, locale, placeholder.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The calendar button: `false` removes it (Alt+ArrowDown still opens the calendar), a node / text / `() => node` replaces the icon.

props.name: labels
props.type: { choose?: string | undefined; prevMonth?: string | undefined; nextMonth?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names: `choose` (the button and the popover, default "Choose date"), `prevMonth`, `nextMonth` (the calendar).

props.name: calendar
props.doc: Extra props for the Calendar in the popover (`{ renderDay, weekdays: false, prevIcon, nextIcon, isDisabled }`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DatePicker.tr: Takvim açılır penceresi olan tarih girişi. Değer: ISO tarih dizesi veya null. Proplar: min, max, firstDay, locale, placeholder.

hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.name: DateRangePicker
hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.doc: Date range { from, to } with presets (today, 7/30/90 days, this month) and a custom from/to pair. Props: presets (array like rangePresets() or false), today, min, max.

props.name: presets
props.doc: Presets (like rangePresets()) or false for only the custom from / to pair.

props.name: today
props.doc: "Today" for the built-in presets.

props.name: labels
props.type: { range?: string | undefined; custom?: string | undefined; from?: string | undefined; to?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: `range` (name of the preset row, "Date range"), `custom` (the last option, "Custom"), `from` / `to` (names of the two date fields).

props.name: custom
props.doc: The "Custom" option after the presets: `false` leaves only the presets.

props.name: separator
props.doc: The mark between the two date fields: `false` removes it, a node / text / `() => node` replaces the "–".

props.name: picker
props.doc: Extra props for both DatePickers (`{ icon, labels, calendar, locale, placeholder }`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DateRangePicker.tr: Hazır ayarlı (bugün, 7/30/90 gün, bu ay) ve özel başlangıç/bitiş çiftli { from, to } tarih aralığı. Proplar: presets (rangePresets() gibi dizi veya false), today, min, max.

hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.name: DateTimeInput
hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.doc: Date + time; value is an ISO timestamp (UTC, like `new Date().toISOString()`), edited in local time.

props.name: defaultTime
props.doc: Time used when only a date is picked ("00:00").

props.name: timeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the time field (default "Time").

props.name: picker
props.doc: Extra props for the DatePicker (`{ icon, labels, calendar, locale, placeholder }`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#DateTimeInput.tr: Tarih + saat; değer bir ISO zaman damgasıdır (UTC, `new Date().toISOString()` gibi), yerel saatte düzenlenir.

hadi-march/ui#dayGridKey.name: dayGridKey
hadi-march/ui#dayGridKey.doc: The day a key moves to in a grid of days (a month view): arrows ±1 day / ±1 week, Home / End the ends of the week, PageUp / PageDown ±1 month (with Shift: ±1 year). null when the key is not a move. `forward` is -1 where the columns run right to left. Shared by Calendar and any other day grid (Scheduler's month view).
hadi-march/ui#dayGridKey.signature: function dayGridKey(e: { key: string; shiftKey?: boolean }, iso: IsoDate, firstDay: number, forward: 1 | -1 = 1): IsoDate | null
hadi-march/ui#dayGridKey.tr: Gün ızgarasında bir tuşun götürdüğü tarihi verir (oklar gün / hafta, Home / End hafta başı ve sonu, PageUp / PageDown ay, Shift ile yıl); tuş bir hareket değilse null. `Calendar` ve `Scheduler` ay görünümü aynı kuralı kullanır.

hadi-march/ui#dayLabel.name: dayLabel
hadi-march/ui#dayLabel.signature: function dayLabel(v: Date | string | number, now: Date = new Date()): string

hadi-march/ui#Debugger.name: Debugger
hadi-march/ui#Debugger.doc: `<Debugger session={session} onStart={run} onReveal={(file, line) => open(file, line)} />`

props.name: onStart
props.doc: Start (idle) or restart (a run is on) a run: the host builds the code with the debugger's calls. No button without it.

props.name: onStop
props.doc: End the run (default: `session.end()`); the host may build the code again without the calls.

props.name: onReveal
props.doc: A frame, a breakpoint or an output line was pressed: show that file at that line.

props.name: sections
props.doc: The sections, in this order (default: watch, scope, stack, breakpoints, output).

props.name: layout
props.doc: How the sections stand: one per row, or two side by side in a row whose divider is dragged (default: watch | scope, breakpoints | stack, then output). A section of `sections` the layout does not name gets a row of its own.

props.name: outputLines
props.doc: Lines of the output shown at once (default 4; it scrolls, the newest line in view).

props.name: open
props.doc: The sections open at first (default: all).

props.name: timeline
props.doc: The timeline of the recording, to go back and forth in time (default true).

props.name: options
props.doc: The switches: pause on exceptions, stop on entry, breakpoints on (default true).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Your icons, by button (false: the button's text only, as its tooltip stays).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your texts.

props.name: depth
props.doc: How deep a value opens at first (default 0: closed).

hadi-march/ui#Debugger.tr: Hata ayıklayıcı paneli: Devam, üstünden / içine / dışına adım, geri adım ve zaman çizelgesi; koşullu kesme noktaları, logpoint, debugger; ve hatada durma; izlenen ifadeler, kapsam (yerel / kapanış / modül) ve çağrı yığını.

hadi-march/ui#debuggerPlugin.name: debuggerPlugin
hadi-march/ui#debuggerPlugin.doc: `<AppUI plugins={[typeScriptPlugin(…), debuggerPlugin({ run: build, evaluate }), codeEditorPlugin()]} …>`
hadi-march/ui#debuggerPlugin.tr: march-app-ui hata ayıklayıcı eklentisi: Debugger paneli, kod editöründe satır numarası oluğu (tıkla ya da F9: kesme noktası; duraklatılmış satır vurgulanır) ve F5 / F8 / F10 / F11 komutları; derlemede kod enstrümante edilir, kayıt üstünde durulur.

hadi-march/ui#decodeCatalog.name: decodeCatalog
hadi-march/ui#decodeCatalog.doc: Decode the generated catalog text (google-catalog.gen.ts) into families, most used first.
hadi-march/ui#decodeCatalog.signature: function decodeCatalog(fonts: string, subsets: string): FontFamily[]
hadi-march/ui#decodeCatalog.tr: Üretilmiş katalog metnini (google-catalog.gen.ts) en çok kullanılandan başlayarak ailelere çözer.

hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.name: deepEqual
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.doc: Structural equality for edited values: plain objects and arrays by content; null, undefined and "" are equal.
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.signature: function deepEqual(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean
hadi-march/ui#deepEqual.tr: Düzenlenen değerler için yapısal eşitlik: düz nesneler ve diziler içeriğe göre; null, undefined ve "" eşittir.

hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.name: DEFAULT_CROP
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.doc: Starting crop: the whole image, no rotation or flip.
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.value: { zoom: 1, rotate: 0, flip: false, x: 0, y: 0, aspect: null, w: 0.84, h: 0.84 }
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_CROP.tr: Başlangıç kırpması: görselin tamamı, döndürme veya çevirme yok.

hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.name: DEFAULT_TOOLS
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.doc: Toolbar buttons RichTextEditor shows when `tools` is not given, in order.
hadi-march/ui#DEFAULT_TOOLS.tr: `tools` verilmediğinde RichTextEditor'ın sırayla gösterdiği araç çubuğu düğmeleri.

hadi-march/ui#defineLayout.name: defineLayout
hadi-march/ui#defineLayout.doc: A Layout with its own defaults (regions, corners, features, title pattern).
hadi-march/ui#defineLayout.tr: Kendi varsayılanları olan bir Layout üretir (bölgeler, köşeler, özellikler, başlık kalıbı); `.extend` ile türetilir.

hadi-march/ui#defineLayoutFeature.name: defineLayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#defineLayoutFeature.doc: Register a named feature (usable as `features={{ name: true | {…} }}`).
hadi-march/ui#defineLayoutFeature.signature: function defineLayoutFeature<O extends object>(name: string, make: (opts: O) => (api: LayoutApi) => void | (() => void)): (opts?: O) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#defineLayoutFeature.tr: Adlı bir Layout özelliği kaydeder (`features={{ ad: true | {…} }}` ile kullanılır).

hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.name: defineMeta
hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.doc: Typed helper for a component folder's meta.ts (name, status, category, composedOf …).
hadi-march/ui#defineMeta.tr: Bir bileşen klasörünün meta.ts dosyası için tipli yardımcı (name, status, category, composedOf …).

hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.name: definePlayground
hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.doc: Typed helper for a component folder's playground.ts (the showcase options).
hadi-march/ui#definePlayground.tr: Bir bileşen klasörünün playground.ts dosyası (vitrin seçenekleri) için tipli yardımcı.

hadi-march/ui#definePlugin.name: definePlugin
hadi-march/ui#definePlugin.doc: Checks and returns a plugin definition (`definePlugin({ id, activate(ctx) { … } })`).
hadi-march/ui#definePlugin.tr: march-app-ui eklentisi tanımlar: kimlik, önce gereken eklentiler ve activate(ctx); dosya türü, panel, komut ve servis ekler, hepsi eklentiyle birlikte kalkar.

hadi-march/ui#defineTerminalCommands.name: defineTerminalCommands
hadi-march/ui#defineTerminalCommands.doc: Commands for every terminal on the page; returns a function that takes them out.
hadi-march/ui#defineTerminalCommands.tr: Sayfadaki her terminale komut ekler; komutları geri alan işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#DevicePreview.name: DevicePreview
hadi-march/ui#DevicePreview.doc: Content shown as on a phone or tablet, with touch behavior.

props.name: touch
props.doc: Mouse acts as a finger (touch dot, drag to scroll, fling, long press). Default true.

props.name: fit
props.doc: Scale down to fit the width of its place (default true).

props.name: fitHeight
props.doc: The most height the fitted device may take, in px (default: the window's height − 160, at least 480).

props.name: src
props.doc: Show this address in the device (an iframe: real viewport, real scrolling, real media queries) instead of children.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the device (default "<device> preview").

props.name: statusBar
props.doc: The status bar: true (default), false, or your own node in its place.

props.name: time
props.doc: The clock text of the status bar (default: the time now), e.g. "9:41".

props.name: homeIndicator
props.doc: The home indicator line (default true).

props.name: camera
props.doc: false hides the camera (island, punch hole or notch) of the device (default true).

hadi-march/ui#DevicePreview.tr: İçeriği telefon ya da tablet kasasında gerçek ekran boyuyla gösterir; fare parmak gibi davranır (sürükle-kaydır, fırlatma, uzun bas).

hadi-march/ui#devOverlayFeature.name: devOverlayFeature
hadi-march/ui#devOverlayFeature.doc: Development aid: Alt+Shift+L outlines the regions and lists the running features.
hadi-march/ui#devOverlayFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: Alt+Shift+L bölgelerin çevresini çizer (geliştirme için).

hadi-march/ui#Dialog.name: Dialog
hadi-march/ui#Dialog.doc: Declarative dialog: `<Dialog open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} title="…" size="md" footer={…}>…</Dialog>`

props.name: dismissable
props.doc: false: Escape, the overlay and × do not close it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no title.

props.name: side
props.doc: Drawer only.

props.name: modal
props.doc: false: a non-modal panel (no scrim, no scroll lock, no focus trap; the page stays usable). Default true.

props.name: closeButton
props.doc: The × button in the head: true (default), false (Escape and the scrim still close), or your own icon / node.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the × button (default "Close").

props.name: motion
props.doc: Entrance of the panel: "scale" (default), "fade", "rise" or "none".

hadi-march/ui#Dialog.tr: Bildirimsel diyalog: `<Dialog open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} title="…" size="md" footer={…}>…</Dialog>`

hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.name: Disclosure
hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.doc: A native <details> section with an animated open/close and a summary line.

props.name: marker
props.doc: The turning arrow before the title: true (default), false, or your own node.

hadi-march/ui#Disclosure.tr: Animasyonlu açılıp kapanan ve özet satırı olan yerel bir <details> bölümü.

hadi-march/ui#distance.name: distance
hadi-march/ui#distance.doc: Damerau-Levenshtein (optimal string alignment) distance; stops early above `max`.
hadi-march/ui#distance.signature: function distance(a: string, b: string, max: number = Infinity): number
hadi-march/ui#distance.tr: Damerau-Levenshtein (optimal string alignment) uzaklığı; `max` aşılınca erken durur.

hadi-march/ui#Divider.name: Divider
hadi-march/ui#Divider.tr: `<Divider />` veya `<Divider label="or" />`; satır içi ayırıcılar için `vertical`.

hadi-march/ui#DockLayout.name: DockLayout
hadi-march/ui#DockLayout.doc: `<DockLayout panels={panels} presets={{ main: { title: "Main", tree: () => row([.25, tabs("files")], [.75, tabs("editor")]) } }} persist="ide" />`

props.name: presets
props.doc: Ready-made layouts by name (`row`, `col`, `tabs`); the first (or `preset`) is the default.

props.name: layout
props.doc: The default layout without presets (default: the first panel, the others at their `place`).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep the layout and saved layouts under this key.

props.name: storage
props.doc: Where (default localStorage); sync or async.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the workspace.

props.name: commands
props.doc: Command id prefix for the palette (default "dock"); false: none.

props.name: onClose
props.type: ((panel: string) => boolean | void | Promise<boolean | void>) | undefined
props.doc: A closable tab's close mark: remove the panel from `panels` here; return false to keep it.

props.name: actions
props.doc: The buttons of a group: true (default), false, or the ones to keep. Keyboard and `api` stay.

props.name: narrow
props.doc: Below this width (px) the workspace is one tab group, no drag (default 560).

props.name: motion
props.doc: The short slide when the layout changes (default true; none with reduced motion).

props.name: icons
props.type: { menu?: unknown; maximize?: unknown; restore?: unknown; collapse?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Own icons of the group buttons.

props.name: labels
props.type: { menu?: string; maximize?: string; restore?: string; collapse?: string; panels?: string; strip?: string } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one.

props.name: id
props.doc: id of the root (an ActivityBar's `controls`).

hadi-march/ui#Drawer.name: Drawer
hadi-march/ui#Drawer.doc: `<Drawer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} side="bottom" snapPoints={[0.4, 0.9]} title="…">…</Drawer>` Closing animates out before the panel leaves the document.

props.name: side
props.doc: Edge (read when it opens). Default "end".

props.name: size
props.doc: Width (start / end) or height (top / bottom): sm, md, lg, full. Ignored with snapPoints.

props.name: modal
props.doc: false: no scrim, the page stays usable, focus is not trapped. Default true.

props.name: dragToClose
props.doc: Drag the panel toward its edge to close it. Default true (needs `dismissable`).

props.name: snapPoints
props.doc: Resting sizes: fractions of the viewport (0.4) or pixels (320). The largest sets the panel size.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Index into snapPoints (controlled). Default 0: it opens at the first listed point.

props.name: handle
props.doc: The grab handle (default true: on top / bottom sheets and with snap points). Dragging the head still works without it.

props.name: handleLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the handle button of a sheet with snap points (default "Resize panel").

props.name: motion
props.type: boolean | { duration?: number | undefined; exit?: number | undefined; easing?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Movement: true (default), false (it appears and leaves at once), or your own timing `{ duration, exit, easing }` (ms; easing: a motion engine easing such as "easeOutBack").

props.name: target
props.doc: Where it opens: the nearest <OverlayScope> (default), the whole page ("page") or a scope element.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no title.

props.name: dismissable
props.doc: false: Escape, the overlay and × do not close it.

props.name: closeButton
props.doc: The × button in the head: true (default), false (Escape and the scrim still close), or your own icon / node.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the × button (default "Close").

hadi-march/ui#Drawer.tr: `<Drawer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} side="bottom" snapPoints={[0.4, 0.9]} title="…">…</Drawer>` Kapanırken panel belgeden ayrılmadan önce animasyonla çıkar.
